#!/bin/sh
# stand-in for bin/kith: records who the run is for, and what it was told; a job called slow-* stays running a while
[ -n "$DIFFTEST_FAKELOG" ] && printf 'kith %s person=%s via=%s job=%s model=%s effort=%s harness=%s task=%s\n' "$1" "${KITH_PERSON:-owner}" "$KITH_VIA" "$KITH_SCHED_JOB" "${KITH_MODEL:-}" "${KITH_EFFORT:-}" "${KITH_HARNESS:-}" "$(echo "$2" | head -1)" >> "$DIFFTEST_FAKELOG"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.stub"; : > "$HOME/.stub/$$"
case "$KITH_SCHED_JOB" in slow-*) sleep 30 ;; esac
exit 0
